questions.prompt: The solubility of a gas in water generally
questions.explanation: Hot water holds less gas. That is why bubbles appear when water is heated.

questions.prompt: Which statement about KClO₃ is correct?
options: Its solubility falls as water is heated
Its solubility rises as water is heated
It is insoluble at all temperatures
questions.explanation: Potassium chlorate is a solid whose solubility curve rises steeply with temperature.

questions.prompt: A solid whose solubility decreases when the solvent is heated is
questions.explanation: Cerium(III) sulfate is the school-book solid that is less soluble in hot water.

questions.prompt: Mendeleev’s periodic table was rejected, because of:
options: The problem of the position of isotopes
The irregularities of the atomic masses of some pair elements
Position of hydrogen in the table was not clearly defined
questions.explanation: School texts list all three as defects of a mass-based table: isotopes, inverted pairs such as Te/I, and the unclear place of hydrogen.

questions.prompt: An inverted pair in Mendeleev's table is
questions.explanation: Tellurium has a higher atomic mass than iodine but was placed before iodine to keep the properties in line.

questions.prompt: Mendeleev left gaps in his table in order to
questions.explanation: He predicted properties of missing elements such as eka-silicon (germanium).

questions.prompt: Hydrogen is hard to place in the periodic table because it
questions.explanation: H can lose one electron like alkali metals or gain one like halogens.

questions.prompt: The number of elements that are placed in the 4th period in the modern periodic table is
questions.explanation: Period 4 fills 4s, 3d and 4p: 2 + 10 + 6 = 18 elements (K to Kr).

questions.prompt: How many elements are in period 2?
questions.explanation: Period 2 fills 2s and 2p: 2 + 6 = 8 (Li to Ne).

questions.prompt: Period 3 of the modern periodic table contains
questions.explanation: Period 3 fills 3s and 3p only (Na to Ar). The 3d block appears in period 4.

questions.prompt: The first period of the periodic table contains
questions.explanation: Period 1 is only hydrogen and helium (1s²).

questions.prompt: Elements present in group IIA are called
questions.explanation: Group IIA (group 2) elements are the alkaline earth metals. Alkali metals are Group IA.

questions.prompt: Group IA elements are called
questions.explanation: Li, Na, K, Rb, Cs are alkali metals.

questions.prompt: Chlorine belongs to the
questions.explanation: Cl is Group VIIA, the halogens.

questions.prompt: Neon is a
questions.explanation: Ne is Group 18.

questions.prompt: The ____________ bonding is formed between cations and anions
questions.explanation: Ionic bonds are the attraction between positive and negative ions.

questions.prompt: NaCl is held together by
questions.explanation: Na⁺ and Cl⁻ attract.

questions.prompt: A covalent bond is formed by
questions.explanation: Atoms share a pair of electrons.

questions.prompt: Metallic bonding is the attraction between
options: Positive metal ions and delocalised electrons
questions.explanation: That sea of electrons holds the metal lattice.

questions.prompt: Any solution is consisting of
questions.explanation: A solution is solute dissolved in solvent.

questions.prompt: In salt water the solute is
questions.explanation: Salt dissolves; water is the solvent.

questions.prompt: The solvent in an aqueous solution is
questions.explanation: Aqueous means water is the solvent.

questions.prompt: A solution is a
questions.explanation: One phase, uniform composition: homogeneous mixture.

questions.prompt: Generally, as temperature increase, solubility of most solute will also
questions.explanation: Most solid solutes dissolve more as the water gets hotter.

questions.prompt: The solubility of a gas in water usually
questions.explanation: Warm fizzy drink goes flat because gas leaves.

questions.prompt: A solubility curve plots
questions.explanation: The usual school graph is grams per 100 g water versus °C.

questions.prompt: KNO₃ is more soluble in hot water than in cold water. This means heating the water
questions.explanation: The curve for KNO₃ rises steeply with temperature.

questions.prompt: How much water is needed to dissolve 10g of NaNO₃ salt that makes up 3% NaNO₃ solution
questions.explanation: For a 3% by mass solution, 10 g is 3% of the total mass, so total = 10/0.03 = 333.3 g. The paper's options treat that total as the amount of water. True water would be 323.3 g, which is not listed.

questions.prompt: The mass of salt in 200 g of a 20% salt solution is
A 10% sugar solution has 25 g of sugar. The mass of the solution is
questions.explanation: 25 = 0.10 × total ⇒ total = 250 g.

questions.prompt: 25 g of salt in 75 g of water is what percent by mass?
A force of attraction that hold the atoms together within a molecule is
questions.explanation: Intra- means inside the molecule: covalent (or ionic) bonds. Intermolecular forces are between molecules.

questions.prompt: Hydrogen bonding in water is an
questions.explanation: H-bonds pull one water molecule toward another.

questions.prompt: Which force is strongest?
options: A hydrogen bond between water molecules
A London force between O₂ molecules
An attraction between two distant balloons
questions.explanation: Chemical bonds inside molecules dwarf intermolecular forces.

questions.prompt: The prefix inter- in intermolecular means
questions.explanation: Inter = between; intra = inside.

questions.prompt: Moving across a period from left to right, ionization energy will
questions.explanation: Nuclear charge rises across a period and the shell stays the same, so it is harder to remove an electron.

questions.prompt: Moving down a group, ionization energy generally
questions.explanation: The outer electron is farther from the nucleus and more shielded.

questions.prompt: Electronegativity across a period generally
questions.explanation: Atoms hold shared electrons more tightly as Z rises.

questions.prompt: Atomic radius across a period generally
questions.explanation: The same shell feels a stronger nucleus, so it is pulled in.

questions.prompt: An element X has electron configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 4s² 3d⁶, then atomic number of the element X is
questions.explanation: Add the superscripts: 2+2+6+2+6+2+6 = 26, which is iron.

questions.prompt: The electron configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 4s² 3d¹ belongs to
How many electrons are in 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁴?
A neutral atom with 26 electrons is
questions.explanation: Z = 26 is Fe.

questions.prompt: Law of octaves was proposed by
questions.explanation: Newlands arranged elements so that every eighth was similar.

questions.prompt: Mendeleev arranged elements mainly by
questions.explanation: He used atomic mass and chemical properties, and he left gaps.

questions.prompt: The modern periodic law is based on
questions.explanation: Moseley showed that Z, not mass, is the true order.

questions.prompt: Dobereiner grouped elements into
questions.explanation: Three similar elements, middle one with average mass.

questions.prompt: One of the following is called a universal solvent
questions.explanation: Water dissolves more kinds of solute than any other common liquid, so it is called the universal solvent.

questions.prompt: Water is a good solvent for ionic compounds because it is
questions.explanation: The δ+ H and δ− O ends surround ions.

questions.prompt: Benzene is a better solvent than water for
options: Hydrogen chloride gas that forms ions
questions.explanation: Non-polar dissolves non-polar.

questions.prompt: Which statement is correct?
options: Water does not dissolve every substance
Sand is very soluble in cold water
questions.explanation: 'Universal' is a nickname, not a literal claim.

questions.prompt: ₁₃Al is present in group number ______ and period ______.
questions.explanation: Al is 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p¹: three outer electrons (Group IIIA) and three shells (period 3).

questions.prompt: ₁₇Cl is in
questions.explanation: Cl is 2,8,7 — three shells, seven outer electrons.

questions.prompt: ₁₁Na is in period
questions.explanation: Na is 2,8,1 — three shells.

questions.prompt: An element with configuration 2,8,8,2 is in group
questions.explanation: Two outer electrons = Group IIA (calcium).

questions.prompt: In modern periodic table, representative elements are denoted by
questions.explanation: A-groups are the representative (s and p block) elements. B-groups are transition elements.

questions.prompt: Transition elements are the
questions.explanation: The d-block is labelled B in the older A/B system.

questions.prompt: s-block elements are in groups
questions.explanation: ns¹ and ns² are Groups 1 and 2.

questions.prompt: Which set is all representative elements?
options: He only, and no other element
questions.explanation: Those four are s or p block A-group elements.
